text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia and neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild monocytosis and basophilia. These findings suggest bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possibly due to hematologic disease or severe infection. Immediate clinical correlation and further diagnostic workup are recommended. Electrolytes, renal and liver function are within normal limits except for mild hyperchloremia.
